ITEM 1 | Thin green beans, bright green with slightly darker shading, smooth waxy surface, straight slender pods about 5-8 cm long, arranged in a loose fan-shaped pile across the upper right of the plate, no visible cooking damage, dry surface with little sheen | 75
ITEM 2 | Cooked dark purple-skinned vegetable pieces, irregular chunks about 2-4 cm with glossy dark skin showing at edges, pale tan-yellow flesh, soft and slightly collapsed, with golden-brown browned and crumbly coating patches, slight oily sheen, piled in a mound at the lower left of the plate beside the beans | 80
